children: Hero MotoCorp Ltd. has received relief from the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT) in connection with an outstanding tax demand of approximately ₹27 crore.
That's for six assessment years from 2013-14 to 2017-18 and 2019-20.
In a regulatory filing, the company said it downloaded an appeal order dated November 20, 2026, from the ITAT portal on the same day.
The order grants relief to Hero MotoCorp in respect of the outstanding tax demand of approximately ₹27 crore.

The company had earlier informed the stock exchanges about the assessment orders and demand notices received from the Income Tax Department for the six assessment years through communications dated April 4, 2024, May 25, 2024 and March 12, 2026.
These updates also covered subsequent rectification and reduction of the demands.
Shares of the company closed at ₹5,536 apiece on the NSE on Friday, November 20.

title: Hero MotoCorp gets ITAT relief on ₹27 crore tax demand for six assessment years
